tools.name: committee_search
tools.description: Find a UK Parliament committee by name and get its id, house, type, parent committee, current sub-committees and contact email and address. This is the first step for the other committee tools and answers "which committee covers X" and "how do I contact it". Source: UK Parliament Committees API. Sea

tools.name: committee_evidence_sessions
tools.description: List a committee's oral evidence sessions, newest first, with the meeting date, the inquiry, every witness with their role and organisation, and links to the published transcript. Answers "when did the CEO give evidence" and "who has the committee questioned on X". Source: UK Parliament Committees A

tools.name: written_question_search
tools.description: Search UK parliamentary written questions and the government's answers by keyword, e.g. what a department has said about potholes, NHS waiting lists or visa numbers. Returns who asked, which department answered, dates, status and an excerpt of the answer. Source: UK Parliament Written Questions API

tools.name: written_question_detail
tools.description: Get one UK parliamentary written question with the government's full answer, by its id from written_question_search. Gives the full question and answer text, who asked and who answered, dates, whether it was a holding or corrected answer, and any attachments. Source: UK Parliament Written Questions

tools.name: unanswered_written_questions
tools.description: List UK parliamentary written questions still waiting for a government answer, most recently tabled first, with the department due to answer and the date the answer is due. Useful for public affairs teams tracking what departments have been asked. Source: UK Parliament Written Questions API (Commons

tools.name: written_statement_search
tools.description: Search UK ministerial written statements by keyword, the formal way ministers announce policy changes, data updates and decisions to Parliament. tools.name: oral_questions_upcoming
tools.description: List House of Commons oral questions tabled for answer at departmental question time from a given date: who is asking, which department and minister answers, and the question text, including topical questions. Answers "what will MPs ask at Home Office questions this week?". Source: UK Parliament Ora

tools.name: early_day_motions_recent
tools.description: List the most recently tabled early day motions (EDMs) in the House of Commons: title, primary sponsor, date, and the supporter count Parliament reports. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "uk-parliament-scrutiny" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: committee_search, committee_evidence_sessions · Private data: committee_search · Public sink: committee_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: committee_search, committee_evidence_sessions · Private data: committee_search · Public sink: committee_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
